versions.content: After initialization of the Ethernet switch within the EthSwt_- BackgroundTask , the Ethernet switch shall enter an inactive or low power mode if EthSwtLowPowerModeSupport is set to TRUE. If EthSwtLowPowerModeSupport is not defined or set to FALSE the Ethernet switch shall enter an active state.
